deliberation_seed.objective: Why did all negative control interventions (alignment_temporal_shuffle, genotype_outcome_permutation, retention_parent_shuffle, validation_label_shuffle) fail to falsify the primary finding, violating G6?
deliberation_seed.research_object: Identify root causes of negative control failures in the LIFE_COG3R experimental design and propose corrections.
rival_explanations: Negative controls lack statistical power (only 12 rows total across 4 controls, 3 per condition) to detect confounds or false positives.
The negative control interventions are insufficiently disruptive because the experimental pipeline has hidden invariants (e.g., fixed seed, deterministic coupling between arms).
The existing evidence for generalization gap improvement is a false positive that negative controls cannot rule out due to design limitations.
deliberation_seed.operationalization: Redesign the negative control suite, increase intervention coverage, and validate control power against known null effects within project://LIFE_COG3R.
deliberation_seed.falsifier: A redesigned negative control set successfully falsifies at least one false-positive signal.
unresolved_conflicts: G4 appears positive while G6 fails, so the primary finding may be artifactual.
Control underpower and insufficiently disruptive interventions remain competing explanations.

problem_candidates.question: Why did validation-gated elitist selection reduce the generalization gap in DayNight and HighLife substrates, while failing to demonstrate retention eligibility or aligned Cbit improvement?
